question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now calculate the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT p.id AS root_id, p.id AS current_id, CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) AS running_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT pt.root_id, pr.contains_id AS current_id, pt.running_qty * CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT p.id 
    FROM packaging p
    LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IS NULL
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT pt.root_id, SUM(pt.running_qty) AS total_quantity
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN leaf_items li ON pt.current_id = li.id
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals

function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Now I need to fully expand each root packaging to find all leaf-level items within each.
-- Let me trace the hierarchy for each root:
-- 531 (Pallet of L) -> contains 521 (qty 12)
--   521 (Box Large) -> contains 502 (qty 72)
--   So leaf for 531: 502, total qty = 12 * 72 = 864
--
-- 532 (Pallet of M) -> contains 522 (qty 20)
--   522 (Box Medium) -> contains 501 (qty 36)
--   So leaf for 532: 501, total qty = 20 * 36 = 720
--
-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> contains 522 (qty 10) and 523 (qty 20)
--   522 -> contains 501 (qty 36)
--   523 (Box Small) -> contains 502 (qty 30)
--   So leaves for 533: 501 (qty 10*36=360), 502 (qty 20*30=600), total = 960
--
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> contains 523 (qty 20) and 524 (qty 16)
--   523 -> contains 502 (qty 30)
--   524 (Gift Box) -> contains 511 (qty 8)
--     511 (Gift Carton) -> contains 501 (qty 3) and 502 (qty 2)
--   So leaves for 534: 
--     501 from 523 branch: none (523 only has 502)
--     Wait, let me re-trace:
--     523 contains 502 (qty 30), so from 534's 523 qty 20: leaf 502 qty = 20*30 = 600
--     524 contains 511 (qty 8), so from 534's 524 qty 16: inner = 16*8 = 128
--       511 contains 501 (qty 3) and 502 (qty 2)
--       So leaf 501: 128*3 = 384, leaf 502: 128*2 = 256
--     Total leaves for 534: 501=384, 502=600+256=856, total=1240
--
-- Let me use recursive CTE to properly expand all levels

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Start with root packaging items
    SELECT p.id AS root_id, p.id AS current_id, 1.0 * p.id AS product_id, 1.0 AS running_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse: for each current item, find what it contains
    SELECT pt.root_id, pr.contains_id AS current_id, pr.contains_id, pt.running_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT * FROM packaging_tree ORDER BY root_id, current_id"}
